entries.title: Dashboard port invalid

entries.resolution: Set PORT to an unused integer from 1 through 65535, for example make dashboard PORT=7332.

entries.title: Dashboard project id missing

entries.resolution: Point CONFIG at a valid project.projectdsl containing a PROJECT <id> line, then validate the DSL and retry.
